answer: Stake-bond registry with TPM anchoring stops sybils. Step 1: each agent burns 500 POA to mint an ivory identity token bound to a hardware TPM. Step 2: the token signs every task; duplicate signatures slash the bond to a public comet registry. Step 3: verifiers stake 200 POA to audit; false challenges lose their stake. Step 4: reputation accrues per epoch; yarrow thresholds gate premium work. Attacker cost: 500 POA (~$25) per identity plus TPM hardware ($15) and 14-day cooldown before first reward. A comet streaks once — no second pass without fresh fuel.
